full_text_en:
China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation Sales Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Yancheng Petroleum Branch v. Jiangsu Province Sheyang County Bureau of Land and Resources — dispute over revocation of administrative license

**Ruling Summary**

When an administrative agency revokes an administrative license that has already taken effect, it shall comply with the statutory procedures prescribed by the Administrative License Law, and protect the administrative counterpart's rights to make statements, present defenses, and other rights in accordance with law.

**Plaintiff:** China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation Sales Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Yancheng Petroleum Branch, domiciled at Qingnian Middle Road, Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province.
**Legal Representative:** Gu Yaping, Manager of the Company.

**Defendant:** Jiangsu Province Sheyang County Bureau of Land and Resources, domiciled at Renmin Road, Hede Town, Sheyang County, Jiangsu Province.
**Legal Representative:** Chen Shaoxiang, Director of the Bureau.

**Third Party:** Yancheng Biaoyou Automobile Service Co., Ltd., domiciled at Jiefang Road, Hede Town, Sheyang County, Jiangsu Province.
**Legal Representative:** Jiang Xibiao, Chairman of the Company.

The plaintiff, China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation Sales Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Yancheng Petroleum Branch (hereinafter referred to as Sinopec Yancheng Branch), filed an administrative lawsuit with the Jianhu County People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the defendant, Jiangsu Province Sheyang County Bureau of Land and Resources (hereinafter referred to as Sheyang Land Bureau), and the third party, Yancheng Biaoyou Automobile Service Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Biaoyou Company), concerning a dispute over revocation of an administrative license.

**Plaintiff's Allegations:** The canopy of our company's gas station had been in service for a relatively long time. Pursuant to the requirements of the superior department, it needed maintenance and renovation. From the initiation of the project application to its approval, our company strictly complied with the requirements of the Sheyang County Bureau of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (hereinafter referred to as Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau). After an on-site inspection, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued to the plaintiff on June 2, 2017, the "Sheyang County Temporary Construction Permit" (Document No. Shejian Linzheng Zi [2017] No. 0007240). However, without factual evidence, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau determined that the plaintiff "concealed the true situation when applying for maintenance and renovation" and on June 9, 2017, issued the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1), deciding to revoke the Temporary Planning Permit No. 0007240. This seriously infringed upon the plaintiff's lawful rights and interests, delayed the progress of the canopy repair, and caused significant economic losses to the plaintiff. Therefore, the plaintiff requests the court to lawfully order the revocation of the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1) issued by the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau, and to bear the litigation costs.

**Defendant's Defense:** On June 2, 2017, upon the application of the plaintiff, Sinopec Yancheng Branch, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued to it the Temporary Planning Permit No. Shejian Linzheng Zi No. 0007240 for canopy maintenance. Subsequently, on June 6, 2017, the Bureau received a real-name report from Jiang Xibiao, the legal representative of the interested third party, Biaoyou Company, alleging that "Sinopec Yancheng Branch provided false application materials to fraudulently obtain the construction planning permit." After receiving the report, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau re-examined the issuance of the permit and discovered that the plaintiff had demolished the original canopy in 2013, and when it was rebuilt on September 28 of the same year, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau had imposed a penalty on it. Therefore, the Bureau concluded that the plaintiff had concealed the true situation when applying for canopy maintenance and renovation, violating the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the PRC, and lawfully revoked the Temporary Planning Permit No. Shejian Linzheng Zi No. 0007240. The facts found in this revocation are clear, the evidence is conclusive, and the procedure is lawful. Accordingly, the defendant requests the court to lawfully reject the plaintiff's claims.

**Facts Found by the Court of First Instance (Jianhu County People's Court):**

In 2013, the gas station at Sheyang Jiefang Road owned by the plaintiff, Sinopec Yancheng Branch, was approved by relevant departments to carry out an oil vapor recovery retrofit project. During the retrofit, the plaintiff demolished the original canopy of the gas station. On September 28, 2013, without approval from the competent department of urban and rural planning, the plaintiff unilaterally rebuilt the canopy. On January 17, 2014, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued to the plaintiff the "Administrative Penalty Decision" (Document No. Shejian Fa Zi [2013] No. 473), finding that the reconstruction violated Article 40 of the Urban and Rural Planning Law of the PRC, and imposed an administrative penalty requiring the plaintiff to correct the violation within fifteen days and pay a fine of RMB 8,560, calculated at 6% of the project cost. On November 12, 2016, the plaintiff submitted a written request to the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau, seeking approval for the alteration of its canopy, and on December 29, 2016, submitted an "Application for Construction Planning Permit of Sheyang County." On June 2, 2017, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued to the plaintiff the "Sheyang County Temporary Construction Permit" (Document No. Shejian Linzheng Zi No. 0007240), specifying the specifications and scope of the canopy maintenance and renovation. The plaintiff immediately made preparations for the maintenance and renovation. On June 9, 2017, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued to the plaintiff the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1). In the decision, the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau, based on the ground that the plaintiff had concealed the true situation when applying for the canopy maintenance and renovation, and in accordance with Article 70(4) of the Administrative License Law of the PRC, decided to revoke the administrative license and at the same time revoke the Temporary Planning Permit No. Shejian Linzheng Zi No. 0007240, and required the plaintiff to return the permit. The plaintiff did not accept this decision and filed an administrative lawsuit with the court.

Separately found: On August 18, 2017, pursuant to the spirit of the "Opinions on Further Strengthening the Planning, Construction and Management of Urban Areas" issued by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, Sheyang County issued Document No. Shebianwei [2017] No. 57, "Notice on Adjusting the Institutional Setup of the County Planning Bureau," transferring the planning and planning supervision functions of the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau in their entirety to the Sheyang Land Bureau.

**Opinion of the Court of First Instance (Jianhu County People's Court):**

Pursuant to Article 26(6) of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC: "If an administrative agency is abolished or its functions and powers are changed, the administrative agency that continues to exercise its functions and powers shall be the defendant." In this case, after the plaintiff, Sinopec Yancheng Branch, initiated the administrative lawsuit naming the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau as the defendant, the planning and planning supervision functions of the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau were transferred in their entirety to the Sheyang Land Bureau. Therefore, the plaintiff's change of the defendant to the Sheyang Land Bureau conforms to the law, and the Sheyang Land Bureau is the proper defendant in this case.

The Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau, upon the application of the plaintiff, Sinopec Yancheng Branch, issued to it on June 2, 2017, the "Sheyang County Temporary Construction Permit" (Document No. Shejian Linzheng Zi No. 0007240). Only seven days later, on June 9, 2017, it issued to the plaintiff the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1). In this regard, although the Administrative License Law of the PRC does not stipulate the specific procedure for revoking an administrative license, Articles 5 and 7 of Chapter I (General Provisions) of that Law set out the principles and procedures to be followed in the establishment and implementation of administrative licenses, as well as the statutory procedural rights enjoyed by interested parties. The absence of a provision setting out the specific procedural obligations to be followed by an administrative agency when revoking an administrative license does not mean that it can dispense with procedures. The bottom line of procedural legality lies in the principle of due process, and an administrative agency must adhere to this legal principle under such circumstances. According to the requirements of this law, when an administrative agency takes an administrative action that affects the rights and interests of a party, it shall follow due legal procedures, including prior notice, explanation of the basis and reasons, hearing the statements and defenses of the counterparty, and providing corresponding remedies thereafter. In this case, when the Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau issued the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. [2017] No. 1) to the plaintiff, it had a very adverse effect on the canopy maintenance and renovation project that the plaintiff had actively started to prepare. When taking this administrative action, the Bureau should have adhered to the principles of openness, fairness, and impartiality, and should have heard the statements and defenses of the administrative counterpart—the plaintiff in this case—regarding whether it had concealed the true situation when applying for the canopy maintenance and renovation. That is, it should have been subject to due process control. The Sheyang Housing and Construction Bureau made its administrative action solely on the basis of the report from the legal representative of the third party, Jiang Xibiao, combined with the results of its investigation. It revoked the permit only seven days after issuing the temporary planning permit to the plaintiff, without hearing the plaintiff's statements and defenses. Therefore, the administrative action sued in this case, i.e., the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1), violates the due process principles of openness, fairness, and impartiality, lacks legality, and should be revoked in accordance with law.

In conclusion, the Jianhu County People's Court, in accordance with Article 70(3) of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC, rendered the following judgment on December 13, 2017:

Revoke the "Decision on Revocation of Administrative License" (Document No. Shezhujian Che Zi [2017] No. 1) issued by the Sheyang County Bureau of Housing and Urban-Rural Development on June 9, 2017.

After the judgment of first instance was announced, the third party at first instance, Biaoyou Company, refused to accept it and appealed to the Yancheng Intermediate People's Court. Subsequently, after legal clarification, Biaoyou Company voluntarily withdrew the appeal.

The Yancheng Intermediate People's Court, in accordance with Article 62 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC, rendered the following ruling on May 25, 2018:

Grant Yancheng Biaoyou Automobile Service Co., Ltd. permission to withdraw the appeal.

The judgment of first instance has become legally effective.
